facts.value: Biomedical Science is a branch of science that understands the biological principles that govern the functioning of the human body and helps in finding new and distinct ways to cure the disease by developing advanced diagnostic tools and therapeutic strategies.

facts.value: This course is beneficial for students who are desirous of teaching at the college level and have skills like identifying blood groups, interpreting results, liaising with medical staff, maintaining records, and writing medical reports.

facts.value: Biomedical Science courses are offered at Graduate, Postgraduate, Diploma, and Doctorate levels.

facts.value: The duration of these courses varies depending upon the course an individual is opting for: 3 years at the graduate level, 2 years at the postgraduate level, and 3 years for diploma courses.
